feedback.finish: These are the polar zones. They are found within the Arctic and Antarctic Circles.

atoms.b: In the Southern Hemisphere, the polar zone only contains ((++Antarctica Asia)), which has no permanent human population. However, in the Northern Hemisphere, parts of some countries do stretch above the ((++Arctic_Circle Antarctic_Circle)).
Countries with areas in the Arctic Circle include Canada, Greenland, Norway, Sweden, Finland and ((++Russia Australia)).

atoms.text: The polar zones are located at the extremities of the planet. For six months of the year, they experience total darkness as they are tilted away from the Sun in space, and then six months of sunlight, when they are tilted towards the Sun.
As Vostok is so close to the South Pole, it experiences complete darkness for six months of the year. This means that there is no way for sunlight to keep conditions warmer.
